# templates/

The project instructions content checklist lives in
[`skills/paf-init/project-instructions-template.md`](../../skills/paf-init/project-instructions-template.md).
It ships with the `/paf:init` skill, which checks a repository's `CLAUDE.md` or `AGENTS.md` against it.
`docs/` is not installed, so the checklist is kept there as a single copy and this file only points to it.
